channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Rip-Off Britain
channel.desc: Residents of an apartment block in Oldham who were forced to leave their flats following the issue of a fire safety notice are desperate to go home after being barred from returning for five years. Also on the programme, the man who has been forced to use portable chargers to power his home after a broadband installer drilled through wires and left a huge hole in his wall. And will new regulations affecting buy now, pay later credit providers satisfy critics of the industry?
